sections.heading: Google AI Momentum
paragraphs: Google has been focusing on advancing its AI capabilities, as detailed in a recent blog post on their official blog.
According to blog.google, Google's AI momentum is set to enter a new chapter with significant developments in the pipeline.

sections.heading: Leadership Changes
paragraphs: CNBC reports that there have been significant changes in Google's AI leadership. Chief scientist Jeff Dean is exiting the company after 27 years of service.
Demis Hassabis has stepped down as the CEO of DeepMind, a subsidiary of Google's parent company, Alphabet.

sections.heading: Stock Market Reaction
paragraphs: Yahoo Finance notes that Google's stock has experienced a drop, which is attributed to the leadership shake-up within DeepMind.
